title: Test suites run faster with no lost coverage
goal: Fresh scenario clones reuse the seed's pack index, test kb copies are hard links of a scanned template, workers start the longest scopes first and match the host's cores, query-log and git scenarios share their setup and drop proven duplicates, throwaway test repositories run no automatic git maintenance, and tests over the repository's live data do not depend on its size

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Rank 5 of the 5 active sprints. Cuts the full suite's wall time without losing a test (fresh scenario clones reuse the seed's pack index, query-log and git scenarios share their setup and drop proven duplicates, tests over live data hold at any size) and keeps the test and benchmark harness working where it depends on a host or a Claude Code release. Last because its gain is speed only, and once ST-tbi3rras “Sprint runs test in three tiers: narrow per task, the gate per landing, the heavy suites once at sprint end” lands the full suite runs once per sprint, not once per landing. The exception is ST-2zl2od7q “Tests over the repository's live data do not depend on its size”: it stops a growing backlog or kb from turning main red and can be worked ahead of the rest. Three items wait outside the agent's reach, and the review cannot start until each is done or dropped: ST-xjb4wykm “Defender's cost on test scratch files is measured and settled by the operator” and ST-pg5jyebo “A Claude session on the Windows host records a run of both suites” need a session on the Windows host (no agent changes Defender, disks or CPU caps), and ST-6fb6kzoa “Load plugins and settings explicitly if claude -p goes bare by default” waits on its trigger, which fires only when a Claude Code release makes --bare the default for claude -p.
